outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram of the experimental pipeline, not a plot.
Panel B consists of representative fluorescence, H&E, and bright-field micrographs, not a plot.
Panel C is a bar chart showing mean lactate concentration with individual data points (dots) overlaid for each group (Normal lung, LUAD, LUSC).
Panel D is a bar chart showing mean lactate concentration with individual data points (dots) overlaid for High pH and Low pH groups.
Panel E is a schematic representation of the immunosuppressive niche, not a plot.
